page.overview:
What is Gatto?

Gatto is an upcoming Pixar feature film. It was announced at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival on June 13, 2025. It will be released in theaters on March 5, 2027, and will be Pixar's thirty-second feature-length film.

The story follows a black cat named Nero. Indebted to a feline mob boss, Nero finds himself forced to forge an unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose.

The film was announced on June 13, 2025, during the Annecy Animation Festival, with Enrico Casarosa set to direct.

In December 2025, it was announced that the film was pushed up by three months to March 5, 2027. This was likely done to avoid competition with other animated movies coming in June 2027 including Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse and Shrek 5.
